info.title: Insight Pre-Trade Safety API
info.description: Oracle-immune-system pre-trade safety checks with verifiable EIP-712 attestation support. The REST pre-trade endpoint supports x402 and optional MPP; the MPP MCP pilot exposes pre_trade_safety_check on a dedicated endpoint. The full MCP tool catalog remains on /api/mcp.
info.x-guidance: REST: GET /api/v1/safety/pre-trade with asset, chainId, action, and tradeAmountUsd. The full MCP catalog uses POST /api/mcp (x402 or API key). The MPP MCP pilot uses POST /api/mcp/mpp and only accepts pre_trade_safety_check. MPP is shown only when enabled; its challenge is authoritative. Every paid result is settled only after the tool succeeds.

get.summary: Pre-trade safety check with verifiable attestation

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: Asset symbol, e.g. ETH, BTC, USDC

parameters.name: targetProviders
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of oracle providers to restrict the check to

parameters.name: protocolId
parameters.description: Optional lending protocol id to evaluate against

parameters.name: schemaVersion
parameters.description: Attestation schema version: 1 (default, 11-field), 2 (26-field, CAIP-19 + quorum gate), 3 (27-field: v2 + signed independence threshold)

parameters.name: destinationAsset
parameters.description: Optional destination asset symbol (v2 binds it as destinationAssetId)

200.description: Safety verdict returned (paid via x402 or MPP, or authorized by API key)

PAYMENT-RESPONSE.description: x402 settlement receipt for x402-paid calls.

Payment-Receipt.description: MPP settlement receipt for MPP-paid calls.

401.description: Unauthorized (paid tier disarmed and no API key supplied)

402.description: Payment Required: x402 v2 quote in PAYMENT-REQUIRED. MPP is discoverable through x-payment-info only when enabled and is available on the dedicated MPP MCP endpoint. API-key callers may also receive 402 when their credit balance is insufficient.

WWW-Authenticate.description: MPP challenge for the REST pre-trade endpoint when MPP_ENABLED is active.

post.summary: MCP tools/call over JSON-RPC 2.0 (streamable HTTP), x402 pay-per-call
post.description: Pay-per-call access to the Insight oracle tool catalog (40+ tools: prices, consensus, peg risk, lending safety) for x402 agents without an API key. Price scales with the tool metering class (C1=$0.002, C2=$0.008, C3=$0.02, C4=$0.04). tools/list and initialize are free. Every paid response carries a verifiable EIP-712 attestation receipt.

200.description: JSON-RPC response (paid via x402 or free method); paid tools/call responses include the EIP-712 attestation receipt in the tool result content

402.description: x402 v2 challenge in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED response header (base64 JSON with USDC requirements and Bazaar metadata). Amount in the challenge reflects the requested tool's metering class.
